title: Income Tax and Social Security Tables 2026
subtitle: Tax brackets and contribution rates for 29 countries, with official sources
description:
## About this dataset

Free, machine-readable **income tax tables** and **social security contribution rates** for 29 countries, compiled by [CalcBloc](https://calcbloc.com) from official government sources for the 2026 and 2026-27 tax years. Each table lists the **tax brackets**, personal allowances and credits, employee and employer contributions with their ceilings, and other payroll figures. Regional tables cover states, provinces, cantons and other regions with their own rates.

Every row carries the official **source URL**, the date it was **retrieved** and a review **status**, so each figure can be traced to the government page it came from.

**29 countries · 213 tables (183 regional) · 7,329 rows · 728 official sources · last verified 2026-11-11**

## Files

- **calcbloc-tax-tables-all.csv**: every row of every table in long format (one row per band or value).
- **calcbloc-tax-tables-all.json**: the same rows as JSON, with dataset metadata.
- **tables-summary.csv** / **tables-summary.json**: one row per table with tax year, last-verified date, row counts, official source URLs and links.
- **DATA_DICTIONARY.md**: every column, unit and status value.

Per-table CSV and JSON files and a Frictionless `datapackage.json` are in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/itmarkerz/calcbloc-data

## Key columns

- `country`, `region_code`, `tax_year`, `currency`: which table the row belongs to (an empty `region_code` is the national table).
- `section_id`, `group` (income-tax, employee, employer, other), `label`: what the row is.
- `from`, `to`, `rate`: tax brackets; `rate` is a decimal fraction (0.2 = 20%) and an empty `to` means no upper limit.
- `value`, `unit` (rate, money, number, text): single values such as allowances, ceilings and contribution rates.
- `source_url`, `source_title`, `retrieved_at`, `status`: provenance and review status.

## Status values

- `verified`: The figure was checked against the official source given in source_url on the retrieved_at date.
- `under_review`: The row belongs to a section that is flagged for manual re-verification: a figure in it rests on a copy of the official page rather than the page itself, a later re-check could not reproduce it, or the underlying record is not yet marked verified. The whole section is flagged, so most rows in it are usually correct. Confirm the figure against source_url before relying on it; calcbloc.com marks the same sections as under review.
- `not_applicable`: A sourced "does not apply" row: the source confirms that the item does not exist in that jurisdiction (for example a state with no labour welfare fund, or a country with no statutory minimum wage). value then holds a short explanation.

## Ideas for use

- Compare top marginal income tax rates or employer social security costs across countries.
- Build a take-home pay or payroll cost model from the brackets and contribution rates.
- Track how tax brackets and thresholds change from one tax year to the next.

resources.description: Every row of every table in long format (one row per band or value).

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country code as used in calcbloc.com URLs and the API (lowercase, hyphenated English name or common short form, e.g. us, uk, uae, new-zealand).

fields.name: country_name
fields.description: Country name in English.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: Region code (state, province, canton, autonomous community, nation...) for regional tables; empty for national tables. Same code as the API's region parameter.

fields.name: region_name
fields.description: Region name; empty for national tables.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code of every money amount in the table (value where unit is money, and the from/to band limits).

fields.name: tax_year
fields.description: Tax year of the table: 2026 for a calendar tax year, 2026-27 for a split year (e.g. UK 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027).

fields.name: is_current_year
fields.description: true for the country's current tax year; false for an earlier year kept for reference.

fields.name: section_id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the table section the row belongs to (also the anchor on the calcbloc.com page).

fields.name: section
fields.description: Section title.

fields.name: group
fields.description: What the section covers: income-tax, employee, employer or other (see Groups).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Name of the band or value.

fields.name: from
fields.description: Bands only: lower limit of the band, in the table's currency (on the basis described in basis). Empty for value rows.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Bands only: upper limit of the band; empty means no upper limit (the top band). Empty for value rows.

fields.name: rate
fields.description: Rate as a decimal fraction (0.4 = 40%): the marginal rate of a band, or the value of a rate row. Empty for money, number and text rows.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value of a money, number or text row (see unit). Empty for bands and rate rows. Numbers are written without thousands separators.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: How to read the row: rate (see the rate column), money, number or text (see the value column).

fields.name: basis
fields.description: What the band limits or the rate apply to, and the period (per year, per month, per week). Empty when it is obvious from the label.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Qualifications or conditions for the row or its section. Often empty.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.description: First day the figure applies (ISO 8601 date).

fields.name: effective_to
fields.description: Last day the figure applies; empty means in force until changed.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Review status: verified, under_review or not_applicable (see Status values).

fields.name: source_title
fields.description: Title of the official source (government, tax authority or social security agency publication, or the law).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: URL of the official source the figure was taken from.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.description: Date the figure was retrieved from (and checked against) source_url (ISO 8601 date).

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The calcbloc.com page that shows this table; link here when you credit the data.
